payload.artist_html: Atterholt J., Hutchison J. H., O'Connor J. K.
payload.credit_html: Статья в журнале PeerJ. https://peerj.com/articles/5910/
payload.description_html:
A cladogram depicting the hypothetical phylogenetic position of Mirarce eatoni.
This is the strict consensus tree (Consistency Index = 0.453; Retention Index = 0.650) produced from six most parsimonious trees (score of 25.1; k-value of 13). These six trees differed only in the relative placement of the five enantiornithines most closely related to the Avisauridae, which here form a polytomy with this clade
